svg.title: Performance journey map of India
svg.desc: A dotted map of India marking performance venues: Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, Puri, Angul, Dhenkanal, Sundargarh, Therubali and Damanjodi in Odisha, with Visakhapatnam, Hyderabad, Ranchi, New Delhi, Agra, Mumbai and Chennai. A magnifier lens over the Bay of Bengal enlarges the cluster of venues around Bhubaneswar.

g.title: New Delhi: Utkal Divas celebration (2004), Shri Jagannath Mandir and Orissa Arts & Cultural Centre (2015), French Embassy, National TV and Doordarshan
Agra, Uttar Pradesh: Taj Festival and Hari Das Samaroh (2015)
Chennai, Tamil Nadu: Utkal Divas celebration (2005) and the International Convention of the Theosophical Society
Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh: Sambaram, National Artists’ Grand Cultural Festival
Hyderabad, Telangana: Hyderabad Odissi Utsav, Astasambhu (2023)
Central University of Jharkhand, Ranchi: 150th Birth Anniversary of Gurudev Rabindranath Tagore
Damanjodi, Odisha: Kabi Samrat Upendra Bhanja Jayanti, NALCO
Bhubaneswar, Odisha: Itikili Mitikili Book Fair, International Women’s Day, International Odissi Dance Festival, Mukteswar Dance Festival, FINCON and more
Cuttack, Odisha: Balijatra Cuttack Utsav, Govt. of Odisha (2012)
Bhubaneswar, Odisha: Itikili Mitikili Book Fair, International Women’s Day, International Odissi Dance Festival, Mukteswar Dance Festival, FINCON and more
